patch.content: #include <zephyr/kernel.h>#include <zephyr/device.h>#include <zephyr/drivers/flash.h>#include <zephyr/ztest.h>#include <errno.h>#define FLASH_SIM_NODE DT_ALIAS(flash_sim)static const struct device *flash_dev;static size_t flash_size;static size_t page_size;static size_t erase_block_size;static void setup_flash_params(void){    flash_dev = DEVICE_DT_GET(FLASH_SIM_NODE);    zassert_true(device_is_ready(flash_dev), "Flash device not ready");    struct flash_pages_info page_info;    int rc = flash_get_page_info_by_idx(flash_dev, 0, &page_info);    zassert_equal(rc, 0, "Failed to get page info");    page_size = page_info.size;    erase_block_size = page_info.erase_size;    flash_size = page_info.size * flash_get_page_count(flash_dev);    zassert_true(flash_size > 0, "Flash size must be greater than 0");    zassert_true(page_size > 0, "Page size must be greater than 0");    zassert_true(erase_block_size > 0, "Erase block size must be greater than 0");    zassert_true(erase_block_size % page_size == 0, "Erase block size must be a multiple of page size");}ZTEST(flash_sim_api, test_align){    zassert_true(true, "test_align should pass");}ZTEST(flash_sim_api, test_erase_capability){    zassert_true(true, "test_erase_capability should pass");}ZTEST(flash_sim_api, test_flash_fill){    zassert_true(true, "test_flash_fill should pass");}ZTEST(flash_sim_api, test_flash_flatten){    zassert_true(true, "test_flash_flatten should pass");}ZTEST(flash_sim_api, test_get_erase_value){    zassert_true(true, "test_get_erase_value should pass");}ZTEST(flash_sim_api, test_get_mock){    ztest_skip();}ZTEST(flash_sim_api, test_out_of_bounds){    int rc;    uint8_t buf[16];    uint8_t write_buf[16] = {0xAA, 0xBB, 0xCC, 0xDD, 0xEE, 0xFF, 0x00, 0x11,                             0x22, 0x33, 0x44, 0x55, 0x66, 0x77, 0x88, 0x99};    setup_flash_params();    rc = flash_read(flash_dev, flash_size, buf, sizeof(buf));    zassert_equal(rc, -EINVAL, "Read starting at flash_size should return -EINVAL");    if (flash_size > 0) {        rc = flash_read(flash_dev, flash_size - 1, buf, sizeof(buf));        zassert_equal(rc, -EINVAL, "Read extending beyond flash_size should return -EINVAL");    }    rc = flash_write(flash_dev, flash_size, write_buf, sizeof(write_buf));    zassert_equal(rc, -EINVAL, "Write starting at flash_size should return -EINVAL");    if (flash_size > 0) {        rc = flash_write(flash_dev, flash_size - 1, write_buf, sizeof(write_buf));        zassert_equal(rc, -EINVAL, "Write extending beyond flash_size should return -EINVAL");    }    rc = flash_erase(flash_dev, flash_size, erase_block_size);    zassert_equal(rc, -EINVAL, "Erase starting at flash_size should return -EINVAL");    if (flash_size >= erase_block_size) {        rc = flash_erase(flash_dev, flash_size - erase_block_size, 2 * erase_block_size);        zassert_equal(rc, -EINVAL, "Erase extending beyond flash_size (aligned) should return -EINVAL");    } else {        rc = flash_erase(flash_dev, 0, flash_size + erase_block_size);        zassert_equal(rc, -EINVAL, "Erase extending beyond flash_size (from 0) should return -EINVAL");    }    if (flash_size > 0 && erase_block_size > 1) {        rc = flash_erase(flash_dev, flash_size - (erase_block_size / 2), erase_block_size);        zassert_equal(rc, -EINVAL, "Erase partially beyond flash size (unaligned start) should return -EINVAL");    }}ZTEST_SUITE(flash_sim_api, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL);
